crossRefs.note: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
Everyone who makes a carved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit. Their own witnesses don’t…
For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman…
Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his…
“What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies…
Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone…
You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away…
Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred…
The inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven; for its people will mourn over it, Along with…
It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be…
I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt. He will burn them, and carry them away captive. He will array…
He will also break the pillars of Beth Shemesh, that is in the land of Egypt; and he will burn the houses of the gods…
“Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal: say, ‘Babylon has been…
Moreover the altar that was at Bethel, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had…
All the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to…
Now when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah, and broke the pillars in…
He did this in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, around in their ruins.
He broke down the altars, and beat the Asherah poles and the engraved images into powder, and cut down all the incense…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
translations.bsb: For this thing is from Israel— a craftsman made it, and it is not God. It will be broken to pieces, that calf of Samaria.
translations.kjv: For from Israel was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
translations.asv: For from Israel is even this; the workman made it, and it is no God; yea, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
